name: EPIC 212406980

text.card: A red giant 3,450 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 1.00 solar masses and 10.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,702 K at its surface.
